business_problem: replace fragmented data sources and slow insight generation with a scalable, near-real-time platform that could support personalization, operational analytics, and self-service decision-making across a fast-growing meal delivery business.
solution_summary: HelloFresh uses Snowflake as the central data warehouse in an analytics stack that unifies operational, customer, and web-behavior data across its direct-to-consumer meal business. Raw data lands in an Amazon S3 data lake on AWS and is loaded into Snowflake, where dbt Core transforms it into trusted analytical models and Airflow orchestrates refreshes so leadership, business, and operations teams can work from one source of truth. Snowplow captures first-party customer interactions and feeds them into Snowflake for deeper journey analysis and personalization, while Tableau and Snowflake-powered dashboards expose KPIs for warehouse throughput, on-time production, supply chain, pricing, promotions, subscribers, and revenue. The managed platform gives HelloFresh near real-time visibility across 18 countries, reduces manual upkeep, and supports self-service analysis without sacrificing compliance, reliability, or cost control.

solution_components.name: Amazon S3
solution_components.role: Acts as the upstream AWS data lake that supplies raw data into HelloFresh's Snowflake environment.

solution_components.name: Snowflake
solution_components.role: Provides the centralized data warehouse and governed source of truth for operational and customer analytics.

solution_components.name: dbt Core
solution_components.role: Transforms raw data in Snowflake into analytical models ready for reporting and operational use cases.

solution_components.name: Airflow
solution_components.role: Automates and manages the pipelines that keep Snowflake data refreshed in near real time.

solution_components.name: Snowplow
solution_components.role: Captures first-party customer interaction data that feeds personalization and customer-journey analysis.

solution_components.name: Tableau
solution_components.role: Delivers dashboards and business intelligence views for operational and strategic decision-making.

data_flow: Operational and customer data land in Amazon S3 and Snowflake, where dbt Core models them and Airflow keeps pipelines refreshed in near real time. Snowplow streams first-party web interaction data into the same Snowflake foundation, and curated datasets are surfaced through Tableau and Snowflake-powered dashboards for marketing, warehouse, production, supply chain, subscriber, and revenue decisions.
business_outcome: HelloFresh achieved 30% cost savings, 99.9% system availability, richer first-party customer insight, and faster operational decisions across warehouse, production, inventory, and supply chain processes.
